rawConfiguration.text:
## Datastores + pipeline (`${environment}`)
**Floci:** collector scrapes `postgres-exporter`, `3x redis-exporter` (users 6379 / chat 6380 / events 6381), `mongodb-exporter`, `rabbitmq-exporter`. **Prod:** New Relic AWS CloudWatch integration (link account, enable RDS/DocDB/ElastiCache/MQ) — panels with `provider = CloudWatch` populate after linking. Client-span panels work in both.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`db.system` = 'postgresql' OR name LIKE '%postgres%')
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND name LIKE '%redis%'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`db.system` = 'mongodb' OR name LIKE '%mongo%')
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS `mq errors` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%rabbitmq%' OR message LIKE '%mq%publish%fail%' OR message LIKE '%amqp%')

FROM Span SELECT average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`db.system` IN ('postgresql', 'mongodb') OR name LIKE '%postgres%' OR name LIKE '%mongo%') FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT average(pg_stat_database_numbackends) AS backends, average(pg_locks_count) AS locks WHERE deployment.environment = 'floci' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT average(redis_hit_ratio) AS `hit ratio`, max(redis_evicted_keys_total) AS evicted WHERE deployment.environment = 'floci' FACET redis_group TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6

FROM Metric SELECT average(redis_commands_duration_seconds) AS `cmd s`, average(redis_connected_clients) AS clients, max(redis_memory_used_bytes / 1000000) AS `mem MB` WHERE deployment.environment = 'floci' FACET redis_group, redis_addr LIMIT 12
FROM Metric SELECT max(rabbitmq_queue_messages) AS depth, max(rabbitmq_queue_consumers) AS consumers WHERE deployment.environment = 'floci' FACET rabbitmq_queue LIMIT 20

FROM Metric SELECT sum(otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans) AS accepted, sum(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans) AS refused, sum(otelcol_exporter_sent_spans) AS sent, sum(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans) AS failed WHERE service.name = 'otel-collector' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(otelcol_process_memory_rss_bytes / 1000000) AS `rss MB`, max(otelcol_exporter_queue_size) AS `queue size` WHERE service.name = 'otel-collector' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
